text:
Maya Patel: handing off to @Nora and @Sam for the night. ongoing: embeddings p99 spike in eu-west and kv-store evictions in us-west. customers seeing intermittent 500s and slowed regenerations. i'm primary until 21:40 PT, then shadow for an hour. pls ack and take ownership.
Incidents Bot: ALERT: embeddings-p99-eu-west breach (p99=1.6s > SLO 1.0s) — 6 alerts in last 5m. page sent to eng-oncall.
Maya Patel: quick summary of what i've done so far: scaled embeddings pool +2 nodes in eu-west (manual), rolled a prefetched-kv clear on primary us-west cluster, and enabled rate-shedding for low-tier tokens for 10m.
Maya Patel: mitigation status:
- scaling: done (nodes added, still warming).
- kv evictions: mitigation attempt: ttl bump and eviction-priority switch — partial, still seeing tail evictions.
- routing: active traffic steering to eu-west-secondary for non-critical customers.
- canary rollback: not triggered yet.
Nora Chen: acked. i'm taking primary at 21:40. can you paste the exact commands you ran for the kv clear and the scaling?
Maya Patel: sure — kv clear command I ran locally against the admin cluster:
```bash
./tools/kvctl --cluster us-west --action clear-prefetch --keys 'regen_prefetch_*'
```
and the scale command (k8s-ish shim):
```bash
./deployctl scale embeddings-eu-west --replicas +2 --strategy immediate
```
Maya Patel: logs I watched: `kv_evictions.log` showed burst of evict ops at 21:05-21:12, correlated with an increase in long-regens.
Jordan Lee: copying runbook pointers in case folks need quick steps: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/embeddings-kv-eviction and https://redwood.infra/playbooks/rate-shedding.
Sam Ortiz: on it. i'll take secondary pager. first step i'll validate that the prefetched clear succeeded and check node readiness.
Incidents Bot: DEPLOYMENT DETECTED: canary/rollout by @ci-bot at 5201234628 for model-slice-3 in eu-west. Status: IN_PROGRESS.
Maya Patel: note — canary started 2m ago, not sure if it contributed to the spike. i left it monitored and asked ci-bot to halt further rollouts until we confirm.
Sam Ortiz: checking nodes — eu-west added nodes are 3/4 ready, one still initializing (gpu-kernel load). watching health.
Nora Chen: customer impact: internal dashboard shows ~8 customers with regen latency degradation, 2 reporting errors. CS is looped in (cc: @support) and has been told we're triaging.
Maya Patel: mitigation recommendations when you take over:
1) keep the extra embeddings nodes online for 15-30m to absorb tail traffic.
2) if p99 doesn't drop within 10m, roll back canary with `deployctl rollback canary model-slice-3`
3) for kv evictions, increase `cache.eviction_threshold` from 0.7 -> 0.82 temporarily (watch memory)
4) if errors persist, enable read-only fallback for low-priority routes: see runbook snippet.
Nora Chen: got it. do we have an estimated ETA for full warmup of the new nodes?
Sam Ortiz: warmup ETA ~8-12m based on current GPU init logs. i'll post updates every 5m.
Deploy Bot: ROLLBACK HOLD: further rollouts paused by @ci-bot at 5201234675.
Maya Patel: customer comms draft (feel free to modify):
"We're currently investigating higher-than-normal response times for some regenerative requests in EU and US regions. Mitigations are in progress; we expect performance to improve within 30 minutes. We'll share another update in 15 minutes or after mitigation progress."
Nora Chen: will coordinate with CS for the 15m update. Sam, once you confirm nodes ready, toggle rate-shedding back off gradually.
Sam Ortiz: confirmed. if p99 < 1.1s after warmup, i'll taper rate-shedding over 5m.
Jordan Lee: if evictions persist, consider temporary KV shard redistribution: command is in runbook but it's heavy — do only if other steps fail.
Maya Patel: handoff checklist for you two:
- [ ] acknowledge primary/secondary (Nora primary, Sam secondary)
- [ ] confirm node readiness and watch p99 (every 5m)
- [ ] keep canary on hold unless rollback needed
- [ ] coordinate with CS for customer messages
- [ ] escalate to eng-sre and oncall-manager if errors > 5% for 10m
Nora Chen: acknowledging. taking primary at 21:40 PT.
Sam Ortiz: acknowledging. will monitor and post back.
Maya Patel: last note: watch for another alert topic — sporadic tokenstore spikes were noisy earlier, but I muted noisy alerts; keep an eye on tokenstore p95 just in case. link: https://redwood.infra/metrics/tokenstore.
Incidents Bot: REMINDER: if page escalation needed, follow escalation ladder: Nora -> Sam -> Jordan -> oncall-manager.
Nora Chen: thanks, team. starting active monitoring now. I'll post updates: 21:45 (warmup status), 21:50 (p99 check), 22:05 (customer update).
Sam Ortiz: 21:45 update: new node warmed to 2/3 fully ready, p99 fell to 1.28s (from 1.6s). still above SLO but trending down.
Maya Patel: :thumbsup: good trend. leaving the thread open; ping me if anything escalates.
Jordan Lee: adding note: if you need quick memory thresholds: set `cache.eviction_threshold` to 0.82, `cache.prefetch_ttl` to +60s, and watch `node.mem.available` < 1.2GB as red.
Nora Chen: 21:55 update: p99 = 1.05s after warmup, rate-shedding taper started. preparing customer 15m update.
Sam Ortiz: 22:04 update: p99 steady at ~0.98s, evictions reduced. removing temporary rate-shedding in 2m if stable.
Maya Patel: thanks all — handoff complete. feel free to close thread when stable.
Deploy Bot: DEPLOYMENT LOG: canary paused; no rollbacks executed.
Incidents Bot: ALERT RESOLVED: embeddings-p99-eu-west returned under SLO for 10 consecutive minutes.
Nora Chen: closing notes: primary (Nora) took over, scaled nodes held, canary paused, cs notified, p99 recovered. closing thread at 22:20.
